title: A healthier plate, with foods you know
summary: A starting point for understanding Jamaica’s food-based dietary guidance.
paragraphs: Healthy eating does not have to start with unfamiliar foods. Jamaica’s Ministry of Health & Wellness describes a balanced approach using the Caribbean’s six food groups: staples, vegetables, fruit, foods from animals, legumes and nuts, and fats and oils.

Variety and appropriate portions matter. The Ministry also encourages drinking water and reducing salty, sugary and highly processed foods. Its food guide offers a useful starting point for conversations about your everyday meals.
If you live with diabetes, kidney disease or another condition that affects your diet, ask your clinician how general guidance applies to you. This article does not replace a personal nutrition plan.
sourceTitle: MOHW Jamaica: Food Based Dietary Guidelines

title: Make room for movement in your day
summary: Find official guidance and discuss activity that suits your abilities.
paragraphs: Movement is one part of looking after your health. Jamaica’s Ministry of Health & Wellness highlights benefits for the heart, muscles, balance and wellbeing, and provides age-specific physical activity information.

Think about activities that fit your routine and abilities. Walking, dancing and other forms of movement can be part of a conversation about becoming more active. A routine should be realistic for you, rather than based on somebody else’s fitness goals.

If you have a medical condition, reduced mobility or concerns about exercising, ask a clinician for advice before changing your activity. Use the Ministry’s resource below for general information; it is not a personalised exercise prescription.

title: Get more from your next clinic visit
summary: A simple checklist for a consultation at Healthy Concept Medical Centre.
paragraphs: Before your visit, write down the questions you want to ask. Bring identification, a current medication list and any relevant referral letters or test results. If you need help accessing the clinic, discuss this with the team when arranging your appointment.

General doctor consultations start at JA$3,000. Tell the clinic which service you need so the team can explain applicable fees and availability. Tests, treatments and specialist services may have different charges.

We are open Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM–6:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:30 AM–3:00 PM, Jamaica time. Online appointment requests need confirmation from the clinic. Call +1 876 669 5974 if you need help arranging a visit.
sourceTitle: Healthy Concept Medical Centre: visiting information
